caller_is_owner.meaning: the caller of increaseLiquidityCurrentRange() is the owner (onlyOwner authority)

pending_tx_observable.meaning: a pending increaseLiquidityCurrentRange() call is observable in the mempool by an MEV bot
pending_tx_observable.checkpoint: before the pending transaction is mined

deadline_protection_disabled.meaning: the transaction expiration protection of the deadline is completely disabled, so the transaction never expires
deadline_protection_disabled.checkpoint: at execution of the held transaction

claims.scope: increaseLiquidityCurrentRange() liquidity increase via Uniswap V3 NonfungiblePositionManager

preconditions.text: increaseLiquidityCurrentRange() is callable only by the owner (onlyOwner).; A pending increaseLiquidityCurrentRange() call is observable in the mempool by an MEV bot.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: A liquidity-increase transaction should carry a caller-provided deadline so it expires and cannot be executed after that deadline (e.g., block.timestamp + 5 minutes).
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: The purpose of the deadline is completely disabled, removing transaction expiration protection.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The owner is the legitimate caller of increaseLiquidityCurrentRange(); the MEV bot observes but does not author the pending call.
The deadline protection is evaluated at the moment the held transaction would execute.

limitations: The 5-minute example in the intent is illustrative, not a concrete bound; no numeric deadline comparison is formalized.
Only the deadline-disabled impact is formalized here; stale execution and value extraction are separate impacts not covered by this plan.
The MEV hold duration magnitudes (1 hour/day/week/month) belong to impact_indefinite_hold, not the selected impact.
